title: AutoGen v0.4 — The Actor Model for Agents
titleKn: AutoGen v0.4 — Agents ಗಾಗಿ Actor Model
desc: How treating each agent as an isolated actor that exchanges messages changes how multi-agent systems scale and fail.
objectives: Define an actor: private state plus a mailbox.
Compare actors with direct function calls.

title: AutoGen v0.4 — Teams, Topics and Conversation Control
titleKn: AutoGen v0.4 — Teams, Topics, ಸಂಭಾಷಣೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ
desc: How teams of agents take turns, how topic-based routing works, and how termination conditions keep conversations bounded.
objectives: Describe team patterns such as round-robin and selector.

title: AutoGen v0.4 — Runtimes, Distribution and Production Concerns
titleKn: AutoGen v0.4 — Runtimes, ವಿತರಣೆ, ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾ ಕಾಳಜಿ
desc: Running agent systems locally versus distributed, and the operational issues of message loss, retries and observability.
objectives: Explain at-least-once delivery and idempotent handlers.
List what to log and trace.
objectivesKn: at-least-once ವಿತರಣೆ ಮತ್ತು idempotent handlers ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
